dataset.description: The new dataset provides a curated and improved transcription of the Corpus Iuris Canonici, with enhanced metadata features. For the Talmud Bavli, while transcription is made available, this is not a new feature. The Talmud Bavli dataset, however, does provide enhanced metadata features.

host.description: Local storage supplemented and synchronized with cloud storage (B2Drop, via Nextcloud) is used to guarantee data preservation. Long-term storage of the data is obtained through Zenodo publishing. The same procedures apply to data and metadata. Data for which no constraints (e.g. related to privacy or copyright issues) is made available to anyone, following the principle of "as open as possible, as close as necessary".

metadata.description:
Metadata in which information protected by copyright is included is not made available, unless proper rights have been explicitly obtained from the copyright holder.
